payload.title: Engineering Manager
payload.description:
Please note that to qualify for this role, you must be located in Poland and hold a valid work permit.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager who brings together three key areas: people leadership, delivery and engineering processes, and contribution to the wider IT organization and knows how to turn them into real impact. 

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll report to one of the IT Directors and act as part of IT leadership within the development teams. Working with up to three teams and 18 direct reports you’ll lead and grow people, shape the way teams work, and drive continuous improvements in development processes. Beyond your team, you’ll work closely with other Engineering Managers and Product Managers, contributing to initiatives that move IT forward. 

We’re looking for someone who thrives on change, brings energy, curiosity and proactivity to their work and knows how to inspire others to do the same. Active coding isn’t part of the role, but you’ll need enough technical depth to understand, challenge and evaluate technical decisions, support your engineers and ensure they deliver high-quality code.

About us: GetResponse is a SaaS company recognized for its industry-leading email marketing and marketing automation software. We’ve been serving our customers since 1998 and are proud to have 350,000+ SMBs and 1,000+ enterprise customers on board. 

 
Key responsibilities: 

Lead and support your teams 

  • take ownership of team performance and key results, working closely with teams and Product Managers 
  • monitor team progress, health and predictability across sprints, cycles and projects 
  • drive continuous improvement of how the teams plan, work and deliver 
  • identify and resolve problems, remove impediments and ensure teams have the tools and resources they need 
  • take responsibility for hiring team budgets, visibility and recognition 
  • support team culture and team-building activities 
  • take care of the teams’ communication channels 


Develop and support people 

  • take ownership of the performance and development of people in your teams 
  • provide regular feedback and conduct performance evaluations, considering both soft skills and technical aspects 
  • co-create career paths, set short- and long-term goals, and support people in achieving them 
  • encourage continuous development and help people achieve better results 
  • provide coaching and mentoring when needed and identify training needs 
  • manage salaries, absences, expenses and bonuses 


Contribute to IT 

  • represent IT within your teams and work closely with other Engineering Managers 
  • contribute to the IT strategy and drive initiatives that develop and improve the department 
  • support knowledge sharing across teams and people 
  • support guild activities 


You may be a perfect fit if you have: 

  • 5+ years of experience in similar roles (e.g. Engineering Manager, Team Leader) 
  • a proven track record in people management and leadership 
  • experience with two or more programming languages or have played an important role on the technical side of software development 
  • practical experience with GitLab, Jira, Claude / ChatGPT 
  • a master's degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience 
  • excellent Polish language skills and English at B2+ level 


Nice to have: 

  • a background as a developer or architect 
  • experience working in-house for a product development company 
  • a background in SaaS product companies 
  • experience working in agile environments 


We are looking for someone who is: 

  • open-minded and has a welcome-change attitude 
  • ready to work in an inspect-and-adapt 
  • positive, with high professional standards and a strong work ethic 
  • passionate and creative as a modern IT manager 
  • comfortable thinking outside the box 
  • focused on high-quality solutions 
  • able to inspire both juniors and experts with enthusiasm for technology 


Salary range: 

  • contract of employment: 17,430–27,020 PLN gross per month 
  • B2B contract: 1,000–1,550 PLN net per man-day 


Extra perks include: * 

  • we work in a hybrid model for those based in the Tri-City area; employees based outside the area work fully remotely 
  • home office setup – a one-time bonus of up to 1,000 PLN (or equivalent) to help set up your home office space 
  • private medical care for employees and their family members 
  • employee referral program – up to 10,000 PLN for recommending a friend 
  • corporate life insurance 
  • employee pension program (PPE) 
  • wellbeing and mental health culture – mental health helpline, sport card, etc. 
  • modern equipment – most of our teams work on MacBooks 
  • English language classes 
  • internal initiatives like webinars, knowledge-sharing sessions, and more 

*Some benefits may be available only to talents hired under a contract of employment. 

 
Apply and enjoy our fully remote online recruitment process! 

  1. Review stage: We’ll check your CV to screen for various criteria and match your talents with opportunities. 
  2. Phone interview: We’d like to get to know you, and vice versa. Let us know why you want to join our team and why you’d be a great fit to us.
  3. First interview: It’s your chance to shine and show that you’re the perfect fit for the role. You’ll meet your future manager, go through the High-level System Design Interview, and get a real feel for what the job looks like in practice. 
  4. IT Leadership Panel: Engage with our IT Management Team in a dynamic discussion, where you can demonstrate your skills and get a feel for our culture – ensuring mutual fit and setting you up for success. 
  5. Offer: If you have what it takes, accept our offer – and welcome aboard! Join our team and be in great company! 


To help us review your application smoothly, please submit your CV in English. 


Magda is the recruiter responsible for this process – if you have any additional questions, feel free to contact her!

payload.title: Growth Marketer
payload.description:
*** Please note that to qualify for this role, you must be located in Poland and hold a valid work permit. *** 

We’re looking for a T-shaped Growth Marketer who can identify and drive opportunities to improve acquisition and conversion across the website, customer journey and growth campaigns. 

A major part of the role is shaping how our website works as a growth channel: how we communicate our value, structure key journeys and help users move towards the next step. 

This is a hands-on role combining customer insight, data, UX, CRO, content, messaging and campaign strategy. We’re looking for someone who can spot an opportunity, turn it into a clear initiative or experiment, and take it through execution and results. 

About us: GetResponse is a SaaS company recognized for its industry-leading email marketing and marketing automation software. We’ve been serving our customers since 1998 and are proud to have 350,000+ SMBs and 1,000+ enterprise customers on board. 

Main tasks: 

  • shape and continuously improve the website from a customer journey, messaging and conversion perspective.
  • identify and prioritize opportunities to improve acquisition and conversion across the customer journey.
  • shape and own acquisition campaigns from strategy through execution, measurement and iteration.
  • define campaign audiences, propositions, messaging, customer journeys and the right mix of channels and touchpoints.
  • develop and run CRO and growth experiments based on clear hypotheses.
  • use customer research, behavioral insights and quantitative data to understand what drives or blocks conversion.
  • get hands-on with research, messaging, content, copy and experiment concepts where it helps us move faster.
  • work with PPC, Design, Sales, Analytics, Product and other specialists to deliver initiatives.
  • support selected projects around activation and free trial-to-paid conversion.
  • use AI actively across research, analysis and execution, while maintaining a high-quality bar.

You may be a perfect fit if you have: 

  • experience owning growth initiatives with measurable acquisition or conversion outcomes.
  • experience shaping and improving websites from a customer journey, messaging and conversion perspective.
  • experience shaping and delivering multi-channel acquisition campaigns.
  • practical experience with CRO, experimentation and hypothesis-driven work.
  • strong analytical mindset and ability to turn data and customer insight into action.
  • strong understanding of customer behavior, UX and digital buying journeys.
  • good understanding of how paid, SEO, content, email and automation can work together.
  • strong content and messaging judgment, with the ability to write and improve copy yourself and use AI to produce sharp, specific, high-quality output rather than generic marketing content.
  • experience working cross-functionally while maintaining ownership of the initiative.
  • strong project management and prioritization skills.

Nice to have: 

  • B2B SaaS or another digital/subscription business.
  • marketing to B2B and enterprise audiences, including longer and more complex sales cycles.
  • free trial, activation or free-to-paid conversion projects.
  • marketing automation and lifecycle communication.
  • customer research, user interviews or behavioral analysis.
  • AI Search / LLM visibility projects.
  • CMS or no-code tools.

Salary range:  

  • 12 000 - 15 000 PLN gross monthly on contract of employment
  • 572 - 715 PLN net/man-day on B2B contract

Extra perks include:*  

  • we work in a hybrid model for those based in the Tri-City area; employees based outside the area work fully remotely
  • home office setup – a one-time bonus of up to 1,000 PLN (or equivalent) to help set up your home office space
  • private medical care for employees and their family members
  • employee referral program – up to 10,000 PLN for recommending a friend
  • corporate life insurance
  • employee pension program (PPE)
  • wellbeing and mental health culture – mental health helpline, sport card, etc.
  • modern equipment – most of our teams work on MacBooks
  • English language classes
  • internal initiatives like webinars, knowledge-sharing sessions, and more

*Some benefits may be available only to talents hired under a contract of employment.  

Apply and enjoy our fully remote online recruitment process!   

  1. Review stage: We’ll check your resumé/CV to screen for various criteria and match your talents with opportunities.   
  2. Phone interview: We’d like to get to know you, and vice versa. Let us know why you want to join our team and why you’d be a great fit with us.   
  3. Hiring Manager Interview: Show off your skills! Meet your future manager and see what’s in store for you.   
  4. Task challenge: Show off your skills! We'll ask you to complete a brief task. We'll suit it to fit your skills and your calendar.           
  5. Team & Leadership Panel: Engage with your potential future teammates and leaders in a dynamic discussion, where you can demonstrate your skills and get a feel for our culture.  
  6. Offer: If you have what it takes, accept our offer and — welcome aboard! Join our team and be in great company!    

Magda is the recruiter responsible for this process - if you have any additional questions, feel free to contact her!

payload.title: Product Manager
payload.description:
Are you passionate about shaping innovative digital products that drive real impact? GetResponse is seeking a dynamic and driven Product Manager to join our team. As a leader in the industry, we are continually looking to expand our product offerings and enhance the overall customer experience. This is where you come in! We are currently on the lookout for an experienced Product Manager who will play a critical role in driving the strategy and roadmap for crucial part of our product – contact management. You will serve as a liaison between the business side and the development team so that the business requirements are successfully translated into product development. 

About us: GetResponse is a SaaS company recognized for its industry-leading email marketing and marketing automation software. We’ve been serving our customers since 1998 and are proud to have 350,000+ SMBs and 1,000+ enterprise customers on board.

Main tasks:

  • define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for the Contact Management area, ensuring an excellent user experience, scalability, and high performance
  • lead continuous product discovery by engaging directly with customers through interviews, feedback analysis, and product usage data to deeply understand their needs and pain points
  • validate customer problems and proposed solutions before development, ensuring we invest in solving the right problems
  • translate customer insights, business goals, and technical constraints into clear product initiatives and actionable development plans
  • prioritize initiatives based on customer value, business impact, and confidence in expected outcomes
  • partner closely with engineering teams to define, scope, and deliver capabilities that help customers collect, organize, and activate their contact data
  • collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Designers, and go-to-market teams to ensure alignment across product development and business objectives
  • facilitate effective communication and collaboration between technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • monitor product adoption, engagement, and customer satisfaction metrics to identify opportunities for continuous improvement
  • make data-informed product decisions and measure the impact of delivered initiatives against expected outcomes

You may be the perfect fit if you have:

  • at least 3 years of experience in Product Management, preferably in a SaaS environment
  • strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • experience working closely with backend engineering teams
  • a solid understanding of backend technologies, APIs, databases, and system architecture
  • experience with product planning, prioritization, and modern product management methodologies
  • proficiency in using AI-powered tools (e.g. LLMs, automated analysis, or prototyping tools) to streamline product management activities such as documentation, data analysis, customer research, and product discovery
  • fluent Polish, as you'll work closely with Polish-speaking engineering teams
  • English proficiency at B2/C1 level (minimum B2)

Nice to have:

  • strategic mindset with the ability to connect platform initiatives to broader business and product goals
  • strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • experience working with quality assurance processes and ensuring platform reliability
  • knowledge of performance optimization, scalability, and system efficiency
  • experience working with complex, distributed SaaS platforms

Salary range:

  • contract of employment: 10 000 - 17 000 PLN gross/month  
  • B2B contract: 531- 1014 PLN MD/nett

Extra perks include:* 

  • we work in a hybrid model for those based in the Tri-City area; employees based outside the area work fully remotely
  • home office set up – a one-time bonus for a maximum of 1000 PLN (or equivalent) to help set up your home office space
  • private medical care for employees and their family members
  • employee referral program – up to 10 000 PLN for recommending a friend
  • corporate life insurance  
  • employee pension program (PPE) 
  • flexible working hours and no meeting days – we want to help you adjust your schedule to your activities  
  • wellbeing and mental health culture – mental health helpline, sport card, etc. 
  • modern equipment – most of our teams work on MacBooks  
  • English language classes internal initiatives like webinars, knowledge-sharing sessions, and more!  

*Some benefits may be available for the talents hired under the contract of employment, only. 

Apply and enjoy our fully remote online recruitment process! 

  1. Review stage: We’ll check your resumé/CV to screen for various criteria and match your talents with opportunities. 
  2. Phone interview: We’d like to get to know you, and vice versa. Let us know why you want to join our team and why you’d be a great fit with us. 
  3. Task challenge: Show off your skills! We'll ask you to complete a brief task. We'll suit it to fit your skills and your calendar.   
  4. Hiring Manager Interview: Show off your skills! Meet your future manager and see what’s in store for you. 
  5. Offer: If you have what it takes, accept our offer and — welcome aboard! Join our team and be in great company!  

Marta is the recruiter responsible for this process – if you have any additional questions, feel free to contact her!
